source.title: Kubaha, Fiala & Lomas (2003), Predicting human geometry-related factors for detailed radiation analysis in indoor spaces

sourceType: vector-digitised regression paths and independent RadTherm simulation marker anchors; not experimental measurements

conditions.sourceDefinition: Frozen torso anterior half-cylinder lateral surface, all body blockers retained; exposed emitting area denominator
conditions.shapeMatch: Corresponding anterior torso; sector boundaries and detailed shape differ from Kubaha

coordinateEvidence.target: front corner-anchored rectangle above the seated reference height; transverse side symmetric for the project chest
coordinateEvidence.limitation: No original Kubaha detailed mesh or complete sector boundary is available locally; external comparison assesses corresponding but different body surfaces.

reference.method: independent exact primitive emission; mesh parity and triangle BVH; own Lambert basis/enclosure intersections; shared emissions across containing rooms; randomized Halton

external.status: Corresponding-surface external comparison; original detailed mesh/sector mask unavailable, so not an identical-geometry certification

publicSourceAudits: Kubaha 2003/2005: local curves and sector metadata, original mesh not supplied
Kocik 2025: appendix local area factors; irradiation/area-factor definition differs and raw mesh not supplied in appendix
Existing display GLB: sphere/cylinder primitives, not detailed anatomy
